name: list_team_flag_settings
description:
Retrieve feature flag settings for projects in a team.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v1/teams/{teamId}/feature-flags/settings --method GET. Fill placeholders from inputs.

limit.description: Maximum number of settings to return.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
